<div class="card-body">
'''We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner!''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ぺしゃんこになっちまう！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ゴミ圧縮装置の上にいるすべてのものは潰される（ロストする）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-278o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ゴミ圧縮装置はゴミを潰して宇宙に放り出す。ゴミの漏出を防ぐため、磁気で密閉されている。Ｒ２－Ｄ２は圧縮装置３２６３８２７の動力を遮断して同胞の命を救った。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' About to Get Flattened!

'''Card text:''' Everything in the Trash Compactor is crushed and lost.

'''Lore:''' Trash compactors crush refuse and eject it into space. A magnetic seal prevents leaks. R2-D2 saved his companions by cutting power to compactor 3263827.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner!]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
